title: Power and authority
log: 2026-10-29T12:14:28Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Power and authority
card: the ability to influence what others think, choose or do. It can come from force, money, knowledge or a person's position.
power that people accept as legitimate, meaning they see it as having a right to direct them. A parent's power over a young child and a government's power to make laws are examples.
Power can exist without authority. A thief with a weapon can make someone hand over a wallet, but people do not accept that he has a right to do so.
Authority is usually backed by shared beliefs about what is fair or proper, such as a law passed by a government that people elected.
draft.remember: Power is the ability to influence others. It becomes authority when people accept it as legitimate.

a.q: Which example shows authority rather than power alone?
opts: A referee's decision is followed by players in a match
A bully makes a student give up their lunch
A hacker locks a company's files until it pays
A gang leader scares shop owners into paying money
a.why: Players accept that the referee has a right to make calls, so the power is legitimate. In the other three, people comply because of fear or threat, not because they accept a right to direct them.
a.clue: Look for the case where people accept the right to direct them.

b.q: Dev's older cousin often gets his own way in the family by teasing and threatening to tell secrets. The family does not think he has a right to decide things. How is his influence best described?
b.why: His influence changes what others do, so it is power. The family does not accept it as legitimate, so it is not authority. Getting results does not make power legitimate.
b.clue: Does he influence others, and do they accept his right to?

a.best: A referee's decision is followed by players in a match
